items.proposed_content: Zero statistics or PT-induced eigenvalue pairing specify useful spectral constraints but do not imply spectral reality. The cited constructions show two kinds of missing mechanism a spectral program must actually supply: a natural space whose zero support is derived through an analytic multiplier or geometry, and a common operator domain on which adjointness, completeness, and self-adjointness are legitimate.
